item.title: Ask HN: Where do you find things worth reading?
item.summary: There’s more good writing and reporting available than ever, but I’m finding it harder to discover the stuff that’s actually worth reading. What are your goto sources for finding interesting things to read about your interests? Could be websites, newsletters, RSS feeds, blogs, Substacks, authors, apps, or anything else. A few I check regularly: - Hacker News - Rest of World: https://restofworld.org/ - Substack: mostly following individual authors/publications rather than browsing the feed I’m especially interested in sources that have helped you discover writers or publications you wouldn’t have found otherwise. What do you read, and how did you find it? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49404106 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
